# MM-P3-L2-HT03 - Maintenance manual - Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P3, line P3-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L2-HT03

Scope
This manual covers routine preventive maintenance and verification steps for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03). It is limited to mechanical, electrical visual inspection and thermocouple calibration activities required to maintain process control and safe operation. Refer to SB-1015, SB-1041, and SOP-P3-L2-01 for related safety bulletins and operational procedures.

Tools
- Insulated hand tools appropriate for high-temperature equipment
- Thermocouple simulator compatible with furnace control module
- Handheld infrared thermometer for surface checks
- Personal protective equipment as specified in SOP-P3-L2-01

Procedure
- Prepare: Verify lockout/tagout per SOP-P3-L2-01 before accessing panels or sensors. Confirm cooldown to ambient following plant procedures in SB-1015.
- Visual inspection: Inspect chamber seals, door latches, and external wiring for damage or contamination. Clean lint and debris from door seals and air intakes using non-sparking tools.
- Thermocouple verification: Remove access cover for sensor harness. Connect thermocouple simulator and compare readback to simulator output at multiple points across the expected operating range. Adjust controller linearization if deviation exceeds acceptance criteria.
- Setpoint verification: Confirm controller displays and logs the austenitizing setpoint for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03) as 870 °C. Escalate discrepancies to maintenance supervision and log per SB-1041.
- Reassembly: Secure all covers and restore power. Perform a controlled heat cycle as required by SOP-P3-L2-01 to confirm stable control response.

Acceptance criteria
- Thermocouple calibration interval for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03) is 55 days. Calibration records must show completion within that interval.
- Controller displays the austenitizing setpoint as 870 °C and maintains stable control during verification cycle.
- No physical damage or unsafe conditions remain after maintenance. All actions documented per SB-1041 and SOP-P3-L2-01.
